description: This file contains unit tests for the React App component, testing rendering, user interactions, and API call mocking using jest and testing-library/react.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Sets up a mock fetch implementation before each test to intercept and simulate API responses.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Resets mock states after each test.

methods.name: test('renders header brand and search UI')
methods.description: Verifies that the main header, brand text, and search UI elements are rendered correctly.

methods.description: Simulates user search input, triggers search, waits for forecast data to render, and verifies forecast information is displayed.
